description: Réseau routier principal avec gestionnaires dans le département du Rhône et la Métropole de Lyon is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. This layer consists of the main road network consisting of motorways, national roads and roads. départementales, the main roads of the Métropole de Lyon (ex departmental roads + BPNL) with information on the managing department and the service in charge of maintenance. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Main road network with managers in the Rhône department and the metropolis of Lyon" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include RDI, RHONE. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
